exposure: Timing of COVID-19 infection during the pandemic (first, second, or third wave)
outcome: High dependency unit (HDU)/intensive care unit (ICU) admission
cohort: 405 pregnant women with active COVID-19 infection at the time of delivery
finding: The second wave of COVID-19 was more severe for pregnant women compared with the first and third waves, with more symptomatic cases requiring HDU/ICU admission and higher maternal mortality, but neonatal outcomes did not differ significantly between the waves.
mod_finding: Cesarean section rate among three phases showed statistical significance with highest (54.7%) in the first wave of COVID-19 pandemic.
